verzen.tekst: If you do good, know to whom you do it,
verzen.html: If you do good, know to whom you do it,

verzen.tekst: Do good to a godly man, and you will find a reward—
verzen.html: Do good to a godly man, and you will find a reward—

verzen.tekst: No good will come to him who continues to do evil,
verzen.html: No good will come to him who continues to do evil,

verzen.tekst: Do good to one who is lowly.
verzen.html: Do good to one who is lowly.

verzen.tekst: For the Most High also hates sinners,
verzen.html: For the Most High also hates sinners,

verzen.tekst: A man’s friend won’t be fully tried in prosperity.
verzen.html: A man’s friend won’t be fully tried in prosperity.

verzen.tekst: In a man’s prosperity, his enemies are grieved.
verzen.html: In a man’s prosperity, his enemies are grieved.

verzen.tekst: Though he humbles himself and walks bowed down,
verzen.html: Though he humbles himself and walks bowed down,

verzen.tekst: Don’t set him next to you,
verzen.html: Don’t set him next to you,

verzen.tekst: Who will pity a charmer that is bitten by a snake,
verzen.html: Who will pity a charmer that is bitten by a snake,

verzen.tekst: Even so, who will pity him who goes to a sinner,
verzen.html: Even so, who will pity him who goes to a sinner,

verzen.tekst: For a while he will stay with you,
verzen.html: For a while he will stay with you,

verzen.tekst: The enemy will speak sweetly with his lips,
verzen.html: The enemy will speak sweetly with his lips,

verzen.tekst: If adversity meets you, you will find him there before you.
verzen.html: If adversity meets you, you will find him there before you.

verzen.tekst: He will shake his head, clap his hands,
verzen.html: He will shake his head, clap his hands,
